mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, user_id,user_name, bool_leader_enum, team_id
mapper.select: SELECT wp.id workshop_id, wp.`name` workshop_name, line.id productionLine_id, line.`name` productionLine_name , gr.id groups_id, gr.`name` groups_name, process.id process_id, process.`name` process_name, process.product_type, t.id team_id FROM mes_building_team_user_link tu LEFT JOIN mes_building_team t ON t.id = tu.team_id AND t.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = t.process_id AND process.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups_team_link gt ON gt.team_id = t.id AND gt.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups gr ON gr.id = gt.groups_id AND gr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON line.id = gr.production_line_id AND line.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop wp ON wp.id = gr.workshop_id AND wp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE tu.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND tu.user_id = #{currentUserId}

select tulink.* from mes_building_team_user_link tulink left join mes_building_groups_team_link gtlink on tulink.team_id = gtlink.team_id left join mes_building_team team on gtlink.team_id = team.id where tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and gtlink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 and gtlink.groups_id = #{assistGroupId} and team.process_id = #{processId}

select tulink.* from mes_building_team_user_link tulink left join mes_building_team team on tulink.team_id = team.id where tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 and team.id = #{teamId}
